name: orders
description: Example API: a GraphQL subgraph that stores orders in PostgreSQL. With an oidc provider it asks every request for a token that carries the client role orders:read (queries) or orders:write (mutations), which the provider gives to the services that say they use it (D22). Its source is apis/orders; build the image with: docker build -t plugbricks-example/orders:0.1.0 apis/orders
